continuity_scope: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition (Beamdog, 2017), English product/manual baseline. The audited in-game witness is only the official manual's first-area Mortuary walkthrough. The pass does not merge original-release mods, the Unfinished Business mod, other Planescape or Dungeons & Dragons works, later adaptations, or unsupported external dialogue transcripts.
work_or_witnesses: Beamdog: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition official product page
Beamdog: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition Manual, Walkthrough: Dead... Again / Top Floor of the Mortuary (pp. 10–11)
coverage_rule: All named individual dramatic agents directly encountered or addressed in the manual's bounded Top Floor of the Mortuary walkthrough, plus the title-designated player protagonist whom that direct witness controls: the Nameless One, Morte, Dhall, and Ei-Vene. This is complete only for the exact opening-walkthrough witness. Named setting figures and later NPCs are omitted unless they are individually encountered within those cited walkthrough paragraphs.
omissions: All named figures outside the manual's Top Floor of the Mortuary walkthrough, including figures named only in product-setting context such as the Lady of Pain, Fell, and Aoskar, and all later companions, antagonists, faction leaders, and quest NPCs.
Classes, alignments, player build choices, memories, beliefs, factions, planes, species, artifacts, keys, tattoos, spells, D&D systems, places, and mechanics as character nodes.
Optional companions, party composition, dialogue choices, quest outcomes, identity revelations, transformations, ending outcomes, and all material after the selected opening walkthrough.
The 1999 original as a distinct release, post-2017 patches/platform implementation changes, the Unfinished Business mod, other Planescape/D&D works, tie-ins, and adaptations.
uncertainties: The Nameless One is a stable title-designated dramatic character, but player choices alter class, alignment, abilities, dialogue, and how information is interpreted; the record therefore does not treat build or later identity conclusions as fixed.
His countless prior lives and resurfacing memories are a source-premise claim; they are unreliable/partial from the protagonist's current perspective and are not expanded with later revelations.
The official manual walkthrough is intentionally spoiler-limited to the first area. Pass-complete here means complete only for its named encounter cohort, not the game's cast.

Enhanced Edition states that English, French, Polish, and German retain original localized voice-over and Korean uses Korean text with English voice-over. This pass preserves English names and does not merge localization variants.

Planescape: Torment is licensed Dungeons & Dragons material. Beamdog's pages establish its Enhanced Edition presentation and license context, not an exhaustive hierarchy for all Planescape tabletop canon.
evidence_basis: First-party Beamdog product material and official Beamdog manual text with page and walkthrough locators. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community transcript, walkthrough, or secondary orientation source is used as canonical evidence.
